staking.name: Zebec SuperApp staking (zebec-stake-sdk)
staking.attribution: Program from Zebec stake SDK / npm @zebec-network/zebec-stake-sdk. Staked balances are credited to each staker and counted inside Retail (TEL-style). Stake-vault custody is reduced by the credited amount so it is not counted twice; positions above vault custody are scaled down so supply is not invented. Reward vaults stay role staking (undistributed rewards, not staker principal); the Supply view counts them in Team because they are developer-controlled. text.holders.held.info: {ticker} in retail wallets compared with {ticker} in custody at known exchange wallets. All chains combined. Retail includes {stakedTotal} staked {ticker}, credited to each staker's wallet from Zebec SuperApp staking (counted once, so it isn't a separate supply bucket).
text.holders.retailHeld.info:
{ticker} held in ordinary wallets — everything except exchange custody, treasury and team wallets, and DEX liquidity.

Shown separately from CEX Balance rather than blended into one total, because the two moving in opposite directions is the signal: {ticker} leaving exchanges for self-custody is accumulation, the reverse is supply moving toward the market. A combined figure stays flat through both.

Staked {ticker} is already inside this figure (credited to each staker's wallet), not added on top.
text.holders.staked.info:
{ticker} locked in Zebec SuperApp staking: the raw sum of every unclaimed on-chain staking position (~4.75B at the 2026-10-28 scan), counted once per staker. It's a subset of Retail Held (already counted there, credited to each staker's wallet), shown separately as a measure of long-term conviction. Staked {ticker} can't be moved until the lockup pays it out.

Disclaimer — Super App "Global Staked" is not current TVL: Zebec's Super App shows a much larger "Global Staked" figure (~18.9B). It equals the sum of the six lockups' cumulative totalStaked counters, which never decrease when a position is claimed, so it still includes ~14.2B that stakers have already claimed out. This site's Staked tile is live TVL — the sum of unclaimed UserStakeData positions (~4.75B) — and the stake-vault balances match it. Solscan links for the staking program, each lockup, each stake-vault token account, and the reward vaults are listed on Staking Overview and under Retail on Supply. The (i) methodology tip has the same proof.

ZBCN Lockup vault gap (2.42%): this one lockup (AYbW5cbZEUgLEj6Eiy3yg74PU3YbEHkbFxgW6fjbSJjp) is exempt from our 0.5% position-vs-vault reconcile check. Its unclaimed positions add up to ~2.42% (~4.39M {ticker}) more than its stake-vault token account (ATA) currently holds. The Staked tile publishes those raw position sums as-is. Supply credits each staker only up to what the stake vaults hold, so that gap is not invented into Retail. Two reward vaults (undistributed rewards, which are nobody's stake) stay outside Retail; they are developer-controlled, so Supply counts them in Team.

staking.how: Staked {ticker} is the live sum of every unclaimed UserStakeData position on Zebec SuperApp staking (program zSTKzGLiN6T6EVzhBiL6sjULXMahDavAS2p4R62afGv), counted once per staker (~4.75B) and credited to that staker's wallet, so it is already inside Retail Held. On Supply that credited amount is the "of which … is staked" line inside Retail, not its own slice. Reward vaults are developer-controlled and counted in Team (undistributed rewards, not staker principal). Zebec Super App's "Global Staked" (~18.9B) is a different metric — the sum of the six lockups' cumulative totalStaked counters, which are never decremented when positions are claimed, so it includes ~14.2B already claimed out. It is not current TVL; do not treat it as the live staked amount.
staking.verify: Open the staking program, each lockup, each stake-vault ATA, and the reward vaults on Solscan. Live TVL matches the sum of unclaimed positions (~4.75B); summing lockup totalStaked counters reproduces the larger Super App figure (~18.9B), which equals live unclaimed principal (~4.75B) plus already-claimed principal (~14.2B). Each stake-vault ATA balance matches its lockup's unclaimed positions, apart from the exempt ZBCN Lockup gap. Reward-vault balances are not part of the Staked total.

supplyBreakdown.how: Total supply is the fixed {supply} max. We split it into the shared buckets that have a balance — Retail (including staked {ticker} credited to each staker), DEX, CEX, Developer holdings (treasury and buyback vaults, team and allocation wallets, and the developer-controlled staking reward vaults; hover or tap it for the sub-category breakdown), Other, and Supply gap — so the pieces add to {supply}. Each bucket is built from on-chain Solana token-account balances of labelled addresses; stake-vault balances are moved onto the stakers who own them so they are not counted twice. The gap below the max reflects buybacks/burns shrinking on-chain supply, not bridges (ZBCN is Solana-only here). Holdings includes the team-cluster signers and allocation wallet 56veX (~400M from team ops 9Sq2 at 40M a month past the Mar 2026 vesting end; recipient unknown; not Team). Exchange custody includes the Uphold/Fireblocks cluster (8gQjn, J8FN, 82P4, 6XHz) and Poloniex Squad Vault SOL-P (Eueeb). Uphold caveat, same as Hot Wallet 3/5: ~545M of buybacks (504.7M as of Jul 2026 plus 40.54M in the Q3 post) may sit inside omnibus Uphold/Fireblocks wallets and cannot be split out, so those balances stay cex. Open a bucket for the addresses and sources.
supplyBreakdown.verify: Open each labelled wallet on Solscan. Vesting end is in the Zebec tokenomics blog and docs (and the Oct 2026 MiCA white paper). Uphold's Canada risk statement describes Fireblocks cold storage; the buyback blog describes Uphold Institutional custody. A Figment/Uphold webinar says assets never leave Fireblocks custody. EkXEg still holds ~108.26M after sending ~437M to team ops 9Sq2.

Per-lockup 0.5% vault reconcile; ZBCN Lockup AYbW5cbZEUgLEj6Eiy3yg74PU3YbEHkbFxgW6fjbSJjp exempt (~2.42% unclaimed-positions vs vault-ATA gap recorded with explainer in output; the Staked tile publishes positions unscaled). pull-holders-rpc.js then credits those positions onto each staker and reduces stake-vault custody (scaled down to the vault balance when positions run ahead), the same way TEL credits the StakingModule.
